board.label: Marker board
board.description: A marker board on a stand: its face toward its heading.

chair.label: Chair
chair.description: A plain steel chair: its front the way one sits in it.

light_pole.label: Light pole
light_pole.description: A light pole, 17 m high, with 2 night lights at its top (Custom Shaders Patch): a flood beam facing forward along its heading and down onto the track, and a spill straight down round it. Its tyres are a tyre stack of its own.

marshal_post.label: Marshal shelter
marshal_post.description: A flag marshal's shelter: a white canopy on four poles, braced from its back; its front to the track. Its chair and its cones are objects of their own.

open_passage.label: Open passage
open_passage.description: A walk-through passage: two side walls under a straight concrete slab, open at its front and its back (one walks through it front to back), 6.4 m across, 7.4 m long.

shed_passage.label: Open shed
shed_passage.description: The white shed open at both ends, a covered passage: one walks through it from end to end.

timing_table.label: Timing table
timing_table.description: A table with two TVs, their screens forward: the session's times and the HotLap Velopark site's page (Custom Shaders Patch displays, as on the table by the hotlap's building).

tyre_stack.label: Tyre stack
tyre_stack.description: Three tyres stacked, the tyre walls' stack: laid along a curve, a tyre wall.
